description: Passes the signed-in person's rebook or change request for a booking to that trip's concierge. Call it only after preview_booking_change has shown the person what would be passed on and they agreed. It changes no booking by itself: the concierge acts on the request, and the outcome appears later in get_updates. Booking changes through an assistant are part of Trip Concierge. With Trip Concierge, you can change, rebook or cancel your bookings through whichever way you prefer — Autonomad's concierge, your own autonomous agent, or an assistant like ChatGPT, Claude or Muse. On a trip without Trip Concierge this returns concierge_required and nothing changes; the person can make the change themselves in My Trips on autonomad.ai.

details.description: What the person wants changed, in their words. Up to 4000 characters.

reference.description: The booking reference the person was given (e.g. ANM-1A2B3C4D), or the trip id.

type.description: rebook: move the booking (e.g. new dates or flight). modify: change something about it (e.g. room, name, request).

name: request_booking_change
